tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Aria speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
